The background shows a domestic kitchen-like environment with shelves, a pink stool, and a blue trash can. (2) A transition occurs to a closer shot of the same dog. The woman's hands are visible as she holds a small white stick-like item. The dog licks its nose and looks up expectantly. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the dog's fur texture and the woman's concentrated expression. The camera is steady but slightly tilted to capture the interaction. (3) The scene shifts to showing a different, darker brown and white Corgi. A pair of legs in dark trousers and black shoes enters the frame. A hand reaches down to offer a green dental stick to the brown Corgi. Both dogs eventually appear in the frame, looking up with wagging tails and alert ears, standing on the same tiled floor in the brightly lit indoor space.
